Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Alain Robbe-Grillet’s spouse was “Catherine Jourdan” based on a misleading search snippet, without opening or verifying the actual Wikipedia page or other authoritative sources. This conflated the actress from Eden and After (Catherine Jourdan) with his real spouse, Catherine Robbe-Grillet (née Rstakian), and incorrectly cited Wikipedia to support the wrong name.
